fields.label: Country
fields.note: API takes the 3-letter lowercase code from the site path (/locations/ind/...), e.g. country=ind. Verified: country=ind returned 15 rows, matching the India facet count.

fields.label: Job Family
fields.note: API value is the slug published in the site path, e.g. /job-family/research-development/... -> jobfamily=research-development.

fields.label: Business Structure
fields.note: API value is the business-structure slug, e.g. businessStructures=electronic-design-automation-eda (the listing itself) or product-lifecycle-management-plm.

fields.label: Remote/Hybrid/Onsite
fields.note: API value is the lowercase path slug, e.g. /remotehybridonsite/hybrid/... -> workplaceTypes=hybrid.

notes: jobs.sw.siemens.com is a Nuxt jobsyn board. The EDA business-structure listing is GET https://prod-search-api.jobsyn.org/api/v1/solr/search?page=1&businessStructures=electronic-design-automation-eda&num_items=10 and returns pagination.total=176 plus a filters object with the exact native facet keys country, jobfamily, workplaceTypes and businessStructures (also talenthiringprograms/militarybases, which are not canonical). The page config window.__NUXT__.config.public.filters declares the same keys and maps display labels to their slugs/solr queries; the UI routes selections as path segments (e.g. /locations/ind/business-structure/.../jobs). Verified country=ind -> total 15. No keyword, sort or employment-type control was observed, so keyword/sort are local.
